threshold.label: Alert threshold (% of the data disk)
threshold.hint: A percentage from {min} to {max}. The alert is raised when disk usage reaches the threshold and clears once usage falls {points} points below it.
threshold.invalid: Enter a number, with at most two decimals, for example 85.

email.label: Additional alert address
email.hint: Optional. Receives the disk alert in addition to the super admins. Leave empty to remove it.
email.unverified: This address is not verified: no code is sent to it. Check it carefully, an error would send the alerts to someone else.
email.confirmHint: Type the new address again to confirm it.
email.confirmMismatch: The two addresses do not match.
email.invalid: Enter a valid email address, for example alerts@example.com.
email.removing: Once the address is removed, the disk alert is mailed to the super admins only. It stays visible in the system overview and in the audit log.

smtp.title: Sending of the alerts
smtp.text: Alert mails are sent through the system SMTP server of the instance, configured by environment variables ({host}, {from} and the related variables of the .env file). Without it, no alert mail is sent: the disk alert is only visible in the system overview, in the audit log and in the application log.
